subject: dsa
title: Surrounded Regions
summary: Mark every O reachable from the border as safe, then flip the remaining enclosed O cells to X.
problem: Flip every region of O not connected to the border into X. Border-connected O cells survive.

steps.caption: Capture every O region fully surrounded by X. Any O touching the border survives.
Mark border-safe O first. This O sits on the border, so it and anything joined to it is safe.
The other O cells cannot be reached from the border. These O are enclosed, so they will be captured.
Flip the captured cells. The enclosed O become X, and the border O stays.
Done. Every surrounded region is captured and only the border O survives.
